KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_HURT: Have you tried NOT getting hurt?
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_SAFEPOCKET: Don't ask me how the safe pocket works. You're not ready for that knowledge.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_SCAVENGE: Sometimes the best stuff can be found in the most unassuming of places.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PREPARED: There's no such thing as being too prepared.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDER: Every Raider has their own reason for going out there. But at the end of the day, we all return to the same place.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RECYCLE: Short on basic materials? Recycle spare items!
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARMORBENCH: Use the Gear Bench to upgrade your Shields.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_FREERESOURCES: Visit Scrappy in your Workshop to claim free resources.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_TRACKING: Tracking crafting blueprints or quests can help you bring back the right loot.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARMORUPGRADET1: Light Shields can be modded from Upgrade Tier 1.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARMORUPGRADET2: Medium and Heavy Shields can be modded from Upgrade Tier 2.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RECOIL: Stray bullets are often a sign of a trigger held too long.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_MULTIPLESOLUTIONS: There are many problems that bullets can't solve - or so I've learned.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_EVERYSHOTMATTERS: Think first, shoot later. Or was it the other way around?
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_DODGEROLL: If you find yourself falling, you can sometimes save your ankles and your dignity by rolling as you land.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARCPLATING: Some ARC enemies have heavy duty plating. You'll need the right gun to pierce through it.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_HIDDENLOOT: Raiders often discard old gear when they find something better - but one person's trash is another one's treasure.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_DONTSHOOT: The sound of gunfire can attract ARC to your location.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION1: Assume the best, prepare for the worst.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION2: Trust your gut when encountering fellow Raiders.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION3: Smoke grenades let you vanish from uneasy standoffs.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION4: I've treated many, many injuries. Not all of them were caused by ARC.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION5: Words of peace are more convincing with a gun to back them up.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_OPENSPACES: Open spaces are often littered with downed Raiders.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_HATCH: Raider Hatches get you home quickly and discreetly - so long as you have a key.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARMORWEIGHT: Medium and Heavy Shields protect you at the cost of slowing you down.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ELEVATORSHUTDOWN: The longer you stay topside, the fewer ways back remain.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARCTHRUSTERS: Flying ARC drones rely on their thrusters to stay in the air.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_LOCKEDDOORS: Locked doors often guard the most valuable of treasures.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_SCAVENGEDRONES: Destroyed ARC enemies can be scavenged for valuable resources.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ACCURACY: You're more accurate when standing still - and your duels look far more impressive.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_EMOTEWHEEL: Many a tense situation has been deescalated with the Emote Wheel.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PINGBUTTON: The Ping Wheel lets you point out dangers and destinations to your Squad.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_TRACKEDITEMS: Ping tracked items to let your squad know what you're looking for.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_QUESTS: Ping quests to let your squad know what you're trying to accomplish.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_REQUESTAMMO: Request ammo by pinging an equipped weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_REQUESTWEAPON: Request weapons by pinging an empty weapon slot.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_CONTAINERITEMS: Ping items in containers to let your squad know what you've found.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_AUDIBLEBARKS: You can toggle whether pings can be heard by any nearby Raider, or only by your squad.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_WEAPONBENCH: You can upgrade your weapons from your Inventory.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREENTIPS_UNARMED: You move and vault faster when your weapon is stowed.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_USABLEARCPARTS: Some lootable ARC parts have a secondary use.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_WEAPONREPAIR: Your weapon's durability degrades with use. Be sure to repair it before it breaks.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREENTOOLTIPS_PRACTICERANGE: You can bring your new weapons to the Practice Range to try them out.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_SAFEPOCKETPROTECTION: Items stored in a Safe Pocket will not be lost if you're knocked out.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_SCARCEAMMO: Ammo is scarce, topside. Make sure you bring enough with you.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_BARRICADEREPACK: Deployables, such as barricade kits, can be re-packed and re-used.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_TRADERRUN: Running low on weapons? Use a Free Loadout on your next run.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREENTIPS_FIELDCRATES: Deliver field crates to Field Depots to earn useful resources.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ENERGYAMMO: Reloading a partially loaded energy weapon will consume the entire energy clip.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_THREETICKS: "Got three Ticks on me yesterday. Felt like the world's worst group hug."
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_AUGMENTESSENTIAL: An Augment is just as essential as shoes when you're going topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_MATRIARCHSOLO: There's brave, there's stupid, and then there's "I'm gonna take on a Matriarch alone." Guess which one's extinct.
KeysToEntries.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_MATRIARCHBASTIONS: We were quite sure it couldn't get any worse - but then the Matriarch called in her Bastions.
